title: CN/V20261019 exact battle-value expressions
$comment: CN-advanced-3.1.0 II.B-01..03 PDF p19–20 and II.D-15..17 PDF p50–51 (one-based). Printed arithmetic is separate from runtime facts and later damage modifiers. BigInt intermediates; final safe signed Number, or final negative-clamped nonnegative ten-point damage. damage.coins reads only the current attack execution's host-projected counts, never RNG/receipts or parent/copied/foreign fallbacks. Evidence syntax does not approve a card.

pokemon.description: Read a host-derived effective stat, not a printed CardDefinition field. Damage counters, HP points, physical Energy cards and supplied Energy units are distinct units. No conversion or fallback.

prizes.description: Read count from the original prize-count query result for this side. needsRuling is never zero or a numeric count.

coin.description: Read one named roll in this exact attack execution. The host supplies a plain own-key map at facts.coins, with each requested key containing exactly own enumerable data heads/tails/flips: nonnegative safe integers satisfying BigInt(heads)+BigInt(tails)==BigInt(flips). Missing rolls are errors, never zero. Other keys are not scanned. No RNG, receipt, owner, scope or parent-execution override.

choose.description: Validate the entire static AST, but evaluate only the selected branch's runtime facts.
